# CaraOS LVO stub-coverage report

Tracks how much of each library's V36+ ABI surface is really
implemented versus declared-but-stubbed. The policy (PHASE3.md
§7 Q4) is **per-LVO granularity**: every unimplemented slot is
an explicit `##pad_run` row pointing at `Croi_LvoUnimplemented`,
so the runtime ordinal of every real function stays frozen as
the surface fills in. A slot is one of:

- **impl** — a real `local`/`syscall` function body.
- **server** — declared; `PutMsg` marshalling deferred (LVO.md §12.2).
- **stub** — a per-LVO `##pad_run` placeholder, unimplemented.
- **reserved** — the 4 library-internal vectors (Open/Close/Expunge/ExtFunc), not application-callable.

Coverage % = (impl + server) / user-callable slots (i.e. excluding the 4 reserved).

## Summary

| Library | ABI slots | impl | server | stub | reserved | coverage |
|---------|----------:|-----:|-------:|-----:|---------:|---------:|
| exec.library | 115 | 37 | 0 | 74 | 4 | 33% |
| intuition.library | 77 | 5 | 0 | 68 | 4 | 6% |
| utility.library | 30 | 9 | 0 | 17 | 4 | 34% |
| cruth.library | 23 | 9 | 10 | 0 | 4 | 100% |
